AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
Qumi controls a music bot on Discord: skipping tracks, adding tracks by title, playing a track immediately, changing the bot's volume, repeat and radio, checking playback, and saving the current track to favorites.
Operational Patterns: - Use 'playTrackNow' instead of 'addTrackToQueue' followed by 'skipCurrentTrack'. - Use 'changeBotVolume' for relative requests such as lower by 20 and 'setBotVolume' for exact levels. - Call 'getPlaybackStatus' to answer what is playing or what plays next.
Constraints: - All functions act on the server and voice channel selected in the app and affect everyone listening in that channel. - Tracks are matched by search, so the returned title can differ from the requested one. - Volume functions need a Discord sign-in and the Qumi helper running next to Discord on a computer.
